name: Sicaran Infiltrator

bonuses.name: Heavily Augmented
bonuses.text: A Skitarius' body is designed to withstand the rigours of war. Skitarii do not bleed and they gain +3d to toughness rolls made to resist radiation, corrosion, and environmental energy hazards.

bonuses.name: Neurostatic Aura
bonuses.text: In effect a jamming device for the brain, Neurostatic confuses and disrupts the workings of those nearby. Those within 6m of any Sicaran Infiltrators take a -1d penalty to any tests based on Willpower, including Conviction and Resolve.

abilities.name: Attacks
abilities.text: Each Sicaran Infiltrator will either have a Stubcarbine and a Power Sword or a Flechette Blaster and a Taser Goad:

options.name: Sicaran Princeps
options.text: A Princeps functions much in the way of an Alpha or Sergeant, directing the activities of a squad of Ruststalkers and infiltrators. If there are at least 5 Sicarans involved in the combat, you may want to replace one with a Princeps. All Sicaran Princeps gain a +1 to fellowship and increase the AV of their Augmetic Plating by 1, to a total resilience of 11. A Sicaran Infiltrator Princeps may choose between the two standard loadouts for Infiltrators.

note: 'Sicaran' (for Sicarian) copied as printed. No Ballistic Skill printed, although it carries pistols. Princeps option: the 'Sicaran Princeps' sidebar (PDF p.31).
